page_title: HOF 0-1 PAU | Hoffenheim v St. Pauli 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 27786.
90+2' The resulting corner from Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) is cleared.

90+2' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the top of the net. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. The linesman makes the right call and Hoffenheim will have a corner.
90+2' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90+2' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Alexander Blessin decides to make a substitution. Danel Sinani will be replaced by Abdoulie Ceesay (St. Pauli).
88' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
86' The game has come to an end for Albian Hajdari. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Cole Campbell (Hoffenheim).
85' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
81' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick into the box and attempts to score with a header. His effort is not accurate enough and bounces away off the bar.
80' Joel Fujita (St. Pauli) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
79' The linesman raises his flag. Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is adjudged offside.
77' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
75' Here comes a substitution. Mathias Pereira Lage is given a rest as he is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
74' Here is a change. Andrej Kramaric is going off and Christian Ilzer gives the last tactical orders to Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim).
74' Robin Hranac comes off the pitch to be replaced by Bernardo (Hoffenheim).
72' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
70' Deniz Aytekin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Danel Sinani (St. Pauli).
68' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) plays a through ball but overhits it.
67' Corner kicks – 7:3.
65' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
64' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nikola Vasilj, who smothers the ball.
62' Substitution. Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) in, Wouter Burger out.
59' Looks like Hauke Wahl (St. Pauli) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

57' Hoffenheim are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
54' The ratio of the ball possession is 58:42.
52' Half-chance! Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) plays a pass into the box, but Nikola Vasilj reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' Hoffenheim hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
48' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
47' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Karol Mets comes off for Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli).
46' Referee Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+4' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Manolis Saliakas and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Oliver Baumann was helpless.
45+2' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45+1' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' A cross to the edge of the box finds Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) who takes a nice first touch and tries to beat the keeper with a quick shot towards the left-hand post. Oliver Baumann pulls off a good save and the score remains the same.
38' The referee gives a yellow card to Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
37' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
35' A player from Hoffenheim commits a rough challenge. Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. There is a free kick near the sideline to St. Pauli.
32' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
30' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' The total number of attempts is 10:4.

28' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Nikola Vasilj anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
27' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) latches onto the ball after a scramble in the box, but his placed effort towards the bottom right corner is far too weak and Nikola Vasilj makes a simple save.
27' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
26' An attempted cross from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
25' Mathias Pereira Lage (St. Pauli) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
23' Hoffenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
21' Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Deniz Aytekin had an easy-decision to make.
19' St. Pauli are ruled offside.
17' The free kick is taken by Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim), but ball is cleared.
15' The percentage of ball possession is – 57:43.
13' Hoffenheim are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for St. Pauli.
10' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. St. Pauli get a corner.

10' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) causes Nikola Vasilj little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save. Hoffenheim force their opponents to concede a corner.
9' The ball is out of play. Hoffenheim win a corner kick.
7' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.
5' St. Pauli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

5' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Corner kick. St. Pauli will have an opportunity.
4' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Nikola Vasilj makes a save.
3' Hoffenheim are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
1' The first half has just begun.
Hoffenheim will kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin is the one to supervise the game today.
